questions.question: 消费最高的 5 位客户是谁
questions.sql: SELECT c.CustomerId, c.FirstName || ' ' || c.LastName AS CustomerName, ROUND(SUM(i.Total), 2) AS TotalSpent FROM Customer c JOIN Invoice i ON c.CustomerId = i.CustomerId GROUP BY c.CustomerId, CustomerName ORDER BY TotalSpent DESC LIMIT 5;
questions.explanation: 统计每位客户的累计消费金额，并返回前 5 名。

questions.question: 销售额最高的 5 个国家
questions.sql: SELECT BillingCountry, ROUND(SUM(Total), 2) AS Revenue FROM Invoice GROUP BY BillingCountry ORDER BY Revenue DESC LIMIT 5;
questions.explanation: 按账单国家汇总订单总额，用于演示区域销售分析。

questions.question: 客户最多的 5 个国家
questions.sql: SELECT Country, COUNT(*) AS CustomerCount FROM Customer WHERE Country IS NOT NULL GROUP BY Country ORDER BY CustomerCount DESC LIMIT 5;
questions.explanation: 按国家统计客户数量，用于演示客户地域分布。

questions.question: 客户最多的 5 个城市
questions.sql: SELECT City, COUNT(*) AS CustomerCount FROM Customer WHERE City IS NOT NULL GROUP BY City ORDER BY CustomerCount DESC LIMIT 5;

questions.question: 歌曲数量最多的 5 位艺人
questions.sql: SELECT ar.Name AS ArtistName, COUNT(t.TrackId) AS TrackCount FROM Artist ar JOIN Album al ON ar.ArtistId = al.ArtistId JOIN Track t ON al.AlbumId = t.AlbumId GROUP BY ar.ArtistId, ar.Name ORDER BY TrackCount DESC LIMIT 5;
questions.explanation: 关联艺人、专辑和歌曲表，统计每位艺人的曲目数量。

questions.question: 每位艺人有多少张专辑
questions.sql: SELECT ar.Name AS ArtistName, COUNT(al.AlbumId) AS AlbumCount FROM Artist ar LEFT JOIN Album al ON ar.ArtistId = al.ArtistId GROUP BY ar.ArtistId, ar.Name ORDER BY AlbumCount DESC;
questions.explanation: 统计每位艺人的专辑数量。

questions.question: 销量最高的 5 个专辑
questions.sql: SELECT al.Title AS AlbumTitle, COUNT(il.InvoiceLineId) AS PurchaseCount, ROUND(SUM(il.UnitPrice * il.Quantity), 2) AS Revenue FROM Album al JOIN Track t ON al.AlbumId = t.AlbumId JOIN InvoiceLine il ON t.TrackId = il.TrackId GROUP BY al.AlbumId, al.Title ORDER BY PurchaseCount DESC, Revenue DESC LIMIT 5;
questions.explanation: 将专辑热度定义为购买次数优先、销售额次之，用于处理热门专辑类模糊问题。

questions.question: 每种媒体类型有多少首歌曲
questions.sql: SELECT mt.Name AS MediaType, COUNT(t.TrackId) AS TrackCount FROM MediaType mt LEFT JOIN Track t ON mt.MediaTypeId = t.MediaTypeId GROUP BY mt.MediaTypeId, mt.Name ORDER BY TrackCount DESC;
questions.explanation: 用于展示维度聚合和左连接场景。

questions.question: 歌曲最多的 5 个播放列表
questions.sql: SELECT p.Name AS PlaylistName, COUNT(pt.TrackId) AS TrackCount FROM Playlist p LEFT JOIN PlaylistTrack pt ON p.PlaylistId = pt.PlaylistId GROUP BY p.PlaylistId, p.Name ORDER BY TrackCount DESC LIMIT 5;
questions.explanation: 用于展示多对多关系和聚合。

questions.question: 每年有多少笔订单
questions.sql: SELECT strftime('%Y', InvoiceDate) AS InvoiceYear, COUNT(*) AS InvoiceCount FROM Invoice GROUP BY InvoiceYear ORDER BY InvoiceYear;
questions.explanation: 展示时间字段处理和年度趋势统计。

questions.question: 2009 年有多少笔订单
questions.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS InvoiceCount FROM Invoice WHERE strftime('%Y', InvoiceDate) = '2009';
questions.explanation: 展示带时间过滤的订单统计。

questions.question: 平均时长最长的 5 个流派
questions.sql: SELECT g.Name AS GenreName, ROUND(AVG(t.Milliseconds) / 1000.0, 2) AS AvgSeconds FROM Genre g JOIN Track t ON g.GenreId = t.GenreId GROUP BY g.GenreId, g.Name ORDER BY AvgSeconds DESC LIMIT 5;
questions.explanation: 把毫秒转换成秒，展示平均值指标计算。

questions.question: 歌曲数量最多的 5 个流派
questions.sql: SELECT g.Name AS GenreName, COUNT(t.TrackId) AS TrackCount FROM Genre g LEFT JOIN Track t ON g.GenreId = t.GenreId GROUP BY g.GenreId, g.Name ORDER BY TrackCount DESC LIMIT 5;
questions.explanation: 统计每个流派下的歌曲数量。

questions.question: 单价最高的 10 首歌曲
questions.sql: SELECT Name, UnitPrice FROM Track ORDER BY UnitPrice DESC, Name ASC LIMIT 10;
questions.explanation: 展示简单排序查询和 LIMIT 控制。

questions.question: 最长的 10 首歌曲
questions.sql: SELECT Name, ROUND(Milliseconds / 1000.0, 2) AS Seconds FROM Track ORDER BY Milliseconds DESC, Name ASC LIMIT 10;

questions.question: 哪位客服负责的客户最多
questions.sql: SELECT e.FirstName || ' ' || e.LastName AS SupportRepName, COUNT(c.CustomerId) AS CustomerCount FROM Employee e LEFT JOIN Customer c ON e.EmployeeId = c.SupportRepId GROUP BY e.EmployeeId, SupportRepName ORDER BY CustomerCount DESC LIMIT 5;
questions.explanation: 统计每位客服负责的客户数量。

questions.question: 平均消费最高的 5 个国家
questions.sql: SELECT BillingCountry, ROUND(AVG(Total), 2) AS AvgOrderValue FROM Invoice GROUP BY BillingCountry ORDER BY AvgOrderValue DESC LIMIT 5;
questions.explanation: 按国家统计平均订单金额。

questions.question: 美国有多少位客户
questions.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS CustomerCount FROM Customer WHERE Country = 'USA';
questions.explanation: 展示带固定条件的客户数量统计。

questions.question: 哪些客户没有公司信息
questions.sql: SELECT FirstName || ' ' || LastName AS CustomerName, Country FROM Customer WHERE Company IS NULL ORDER BY CustomerName ASC LIMIT 10;
